questions.question: At which ground did Dragons record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval — largest win by runs of 331, against Boland on 2019/02/02.

questions.question: Dragons set a database record (14/15 season, T20) with a value of 191. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Dragons.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Catches (Fielding)' (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Yolandi Potgieter holds it, with a total of 80.

questions.question: At which ground did Zintle Kula record their career-best innings (50, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Lions on 2024/10/05.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 3 wickets in a match double more times, Jana Nell or Susan Benade?
questions.explanation: Jana Nell: 1 times. Susan Benade: 2 times.

questions.question: South Africa Women have only ever won one Test match in their history. Who was the opponent, and in what year?
questions.explanation: South Africa's sole Test victory came against the Netherlands in 2007, the only Test the two sides have ever played against each other.
